decisive_spans.text: Next generation sequencing (NGS) detected a pathogenic variant in the FH gene (FHc.999C > A p.Cys333Ter)
Global loss of expression of FH
Spindle cell tumor composed of elongated cells arranged in long sweeping to poorly formed fascicles

response.rationale: D10 is strongly supported by the presence of a pathogenic FH gene variant, global loss of FH expression, and the characteristic histopathological findings of a spindle cell tumor with a diffuse hemangiopericytomatous pattern of vasculature. D3 is also supported by the FH gene variant and breast nodules, but D10 provides a more comprehensive explanation for the pelvic mass and its specific histological features.
